To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of rice bran to yam flour improved the nutrient composition and reduced serum cholesterol and triglyceride levels in rats.
the rice bran enriched yams flour has the potential to lower serum lipid levels in rats.
the substitution of yam with rice bran flour improves the nutrient profile, reduces the bad cholesterol and raises the good cholesterol in the blood of rats.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the proximate composition and the hyperlipidemia-lowering potential of rice bran flour enriched with yam (Dioscorea spp.) flour.
the proximate composition and functional properties of yam flour substituted with rice bran particles.
the development of rice bran enriched flour from yam.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, rice bran enriched with the yam flour has improved the proximate composition of the yam flour, increased the dietary fibre content of yam flour, improved the functional properties of the yam and rice bran flour and reduced the serum lipid profile of rats fed the flours.
the addition of rice bran flour to yam flour improves its nutritional value and reduces the 'bad' blood serum cholesterol.
, substitution of rice bran flour for yam flour improved the protein content and the functional properties of the flour.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
rice bran flour can be used to replace yam flour in the formulation of composite flour.
the substitution of yam (Dioscorea rotundata) flour with rice bran (Oryza sativa L.) flour increased the protein and dietary fibre contents and reduced the bulk density and water absorption capacity.
the substitution of yam for rice bran flour in yam flour improved its nutrient composition, reduced 'bad' cholesterol and raised 'good' cholesterol.
The main takeaway from our work is that
rice bran enriched yams flour is a better source of nutrients and dietary fibre and can be used to improve the health of people with high cholesterol.

the substitution of rice bran particles for yam flour in yam flour based products will improve the nutrient composition and functional properties of yam flour based foods and reduce the risk of hyperlipidemia.
rice bran flour can be used as a substitute for yam flour to improve the nutritional quality of the yam flour and reduce the 'bad' cholesterol in blood serum.
